title: DoorDash moves its Q3 earnings release from November 4 to before the market opens on October 29, amid reports of an imminent ~$17B deal to acquire Instacart (Ville Heiskanen/Bloomberg)
summary: Ville Heiskanen / Bloomberg: DoorDash moves its Q3 earnings release from November 4 to before the market opens on October 29, amid reports of an imminent ~$17B deal to acquire Instacart — DoorDash Inc., the food delivery provider in talks to take over Instacart, moved its earnings release date forward by almost a week.
